decision.othersFirst: Decide the other payments for these registrations before accepting this one.

batch.recorded: Offline payment recorded. The registrations are confirmed.

record.title: Record an offline payment
record.lead: For a cheque, bank transfer or cash FOA has received for this payment. Recording it confirms the registrations, exactly as an online payment would, and sends the payer a receipt.
record.notOpen: An offline payment can only be recorded for a payment nobody has paid yet.

reference.label: Reference
reference.hint: The 6-digit cheque number, the bank's transfer reference (UTR), or FOA's cash receipt number.

receivedOn.label: Date received
receivedOn.hint: The day the money reached FOA, in India.

proof.label: Proof
proof.hint: A scan or photo of the cheque, the bank's advice or the cash receipt: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB. Only FOA's finance team can open it.

errors.reference_invalid: Enter the reference as it's written: a cheque number has 6 digits, a transfer reference 8 to 35 letters and numbers.
errors.amount_invalid: Enter the amount in rupees, for example 2,000.
errors.amount_mismatch: The amount must be exactly this payment's amount. Part payments can't be recorded.
errors.received_on_invalid: Enter the date the money arrived.
errors.received_in_future: The date can't be in the future.
errors.received_too_long_ago: The date can't be more than a year ago. Check the year.

alerts.proof_invalid: Choose the scan or photo of the payment to upload with it.

alerts.type_not_allowed: The proof must be a PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
